blocking_criterion.criterion: Unchanged current Evidence is reused only when fingerprints match.

repair_summary: select_gates now reuses Evidence only when EvidenceV2.stored_fingerprint exists and equals evidence.fingerprint(); current passed Evidence with no stored fingerprint is treated as stale for selection and rerun rationale.

code_changes.detail: Added _stored_fingerprint_matches(evidence) and gated reusedEvidenceRefs on stored_fingerprint presence plus exact canonical fingerprint equality.
Added fingerprint_not_matched:<evidence_id> rationale for current passed Evidence that cannot be reused because no matching stored fingerprint is present.
Extended test_reuse_requires_current_evidence_and_matching_fingerprint with EVD-no-stored-fingerprint to match the verifier probe.

independent_probe_reproduction.command: PowerShell here-string piped to uv run python -B -
